thread:
sana: Heads-up — the TS client is adding a typed policy header to support route-level semantics. Thinking of calling it `x-rd-route-policy`. This will let frontend SDKs opt into per-request routing hints.

mike: Is this a pure header rename or new behavior that affects quota attribution?

sana: New semantic. If present it can influence routing decisions (priority/region/cost-tier). Quota ledger will need to attribute differently when the header exists.

ashley: UX question: if console dashboards map by route id today, how do we surface route-policy variants? We risk exploding cardinality.

greg-devex: +1 on cardinality risk. Suggest we map a normalized label for console (eg. `route_policy_group`) and keep raw header in telemetry for debug only.

olivia: What's the backwards compat story for old clients (py/go) — will missing header change behavior?

tom-ts-sdk: Default behavior unchanged. TS will only send header if dev passes a typed policy object. But there is a risk: some customers might start sending the header from the browser and expect client-side semantics.

nora-py-sdk: We need to be explicit in release notes. Also, the Python SDK has a middleware that canonicalizes routing headers — will that drop unknown keys? I can add a safe-pass-through but need to coordinate.

lee-go-sdk: Go binary users often set env var overrides. If we add a new header the proxy could interpret it and change capacity assignment. We should gate routing logic behind a feature flag in the control plane.

sana: Proposal: 1) Add header `x-rd-route-policy` in TS opt-in. 2) Control-plane will ignore the header unless customer's tenant has `route_policy_opt_in` flag. 3) Console will expose `route_policy_group` derived label for charts. 4) Telemetry retains raw header sampled at 0.1% by default.

tom-ts-sdk: Sounds sane. For the header format we'll use compact JSON base64 to avoid weird characters: `X-RD-Route-Policy: eyJwcm9pb3JpdHkiOiAicHJvIiwgInJlZ2lvbiI6ICJ1cy1lYyJ9` — example.

mike: Can we instead use structured fields like `x-rd-rpolicy` kv pairs? Base64 JSON might be opaque in logs.

sana: We weighed both. Base64 JSON avoids header parsing collisions and is forward-compatible for richer policy objects.

greg-devex: On dashboards: emit a normalized `route_policy_group` tag computed by control-plane. Devex will add a toggle in the route explorer to group by that field. Also add a note about sampling for raw header telemetry.

nora-py-sdk: I'll add a no-op passthrough in Python SDK so existing traffic isn't mutated. Also add an env var `RD_ROUTE_POLICY_ENABLED` that mirrors control-plane opt-in for local dev.

lee-go-sdk: We'll add a shim in the proxy that honors the control-plane flag. If disabled, shim strips the header before routing. If enabled, it validates against policy schema.

infra-bot: deploy-checklist created: infra/615-orchestration/617777. Tasks: proxy-shim, control-plane flag, telemetry mapping, console tile.

ashley: Rollout plan idea: 1) Internal canary (redwood-self), 2) opt-in customers (explicit), 3) gradual enable by percent for eligible tenants. We need docs and migration checklist.

tom-ts-sdk: Can we add a compile-time TTL on typed policy so SDKs warn when API shape changes? TS can log a deprecation notice if unknown keys are present.

mike: Quota attribution: when header present attribute usage to `route_policy_group` instead of raw route. We need to update billing docs — finance will want to sign off.

sana: Agreed. I'll loop in finance. Also, telemetry sampling: default 0.1% raw header retention, 100% for `route_policy_group` label (aggregated). That keeps dashboards accurate w/o raw blowup.

greg-devex: I'll draft console mockups for the grouping and add a toggle for 'show raw policy header' which loads sampled traces only.

nora-py-sdk: I'll prepare a small compatibility test: send legacy calls and with header, assert routing unchanged when tenant opt-in is off.

lee-go-sdk: Plan for emergency rollback: proxy can strip header at edge; control-plane flag can be toggled instantly. Good.

olivia: Timeline? Customers asked for end-of-next-week demo.

sana: Target: internal canary by Wed, docs and SDK opt-in PRs by Thu, opt-in customers on Fri. Can we commit to that? If anything slips call it out.

tom-ts-sdk: PR for TS client ready today, will add feature flag and docs.

nora-py-sdk: I'll open a PR tomorrow for passthrough and env-var support.

lee-go-sdk: Proxy shim PR Monday morning.

mike: Finance: @sana please paste the proposed quota attribution change so we can run numbers in the billing model.

sana: Will do — short write-up incoming.

deploy-bot: Note: staged deploy window scheduled 2026-03-23 02:00-04:00 UTC. Mark if you need a different slot.

sana: Thanks everyone. If you have objections to the control-plane opt-in approach speak up now or we'll move forward with infra ticket and canary plan. :thumbsup:
